title: Uno DX
overview: Uno DX is a digital adaptation of the popular multiplayer card game Uno. The main attraction is the Advanced Uno story mode, which features a cast of bombastic anime characters and is set in a Japanese high school. This mode follows the protagonist Shunichi and is structured like an adventure game, with the player visiting various locations around the school, meeting the other characters and witnessing various events, and of course playing rounds of Uno against up to five other characters to settle their differences. Also included is a standard quick play mode of the card game for one or two players, with 11 different characters available to play as or against.
